rationale: The plan matches the design precisely: raw counts, 6v6 unpaired, single batch, DESeq2 Wald on ~condition with control explicitly releveled as reference and the contrast named by factor/numerator/denominator, plus an edgeR QL cross-check on the same filtered set. QC is dataset-specific rather than boilerplate: blind VST PCA, Euclidean sample-distance heatmap, per-sample library sizes and detected genes, and an explicit stated keep/remove decision for sample_01 with the rule that depth alone is not grounds for exclusion. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, tied to the smaller group size) is minimal and justified, normalization is internal (median-of-ratios; TMM for edgeR) with no pre-normalized input, and inference uses BH at a stated alpha=0.05 with apeglm shrinkage for reported effects plus p-value histogram, Cook's/independent-filtering NA bookkeeping, and MA/dispersion diagnostics. Enrichment is preranked fgsea on the full tested list ranked by the Wald statistic against named, versioned Hallmark (15-500) with a stated universe and a sensible rule against ORA on a short list. Reporting covers versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant counts, leading edges, and reproducibility; it is slightly thin only on stating the design's intrinsic caveats (observational, unpaired, no batch term) beyond the sample_01 and method-dependence notes."}
